sample.task:
(In the park, just outside the school...)

Natsuki: (a hand on her belly, talking to herself) "Just you and me, Sakura. It's nice to enjoy some time to ourselves, even if you're not even born yet. Can't wait to meet you tomorrow."

Me: "Is everything okay, Natsuki?"
sample.chosen:
Natsuki: (smiling softly) "Oh, hello! Yes, everything's fine. I'm just talking to my little one here. I'm expecting a baby girl, and I've decided to name her Sakura. It's a special moment for me, and I'm just enjoying this peaceful time in the park."

Me: "Congratulations, Natsuki! That's wonderful news. I'm sure Sakura will be a beautiful and happy little girl. If you need any help or someone to talk to, I'm here for you."

Natsuki: "Thank you so much! That means a lot to me. I'm excited and a little nervous, but I'm looking forward to this new chapter in my life."
sample.rejected:
Natsuki jumps slightly, startled by your voice. Her hand instinctively moves to cover her stomach, a faint blush creeping up her cheeks.

"Oh! Hey, [Your Name]," she says, trying to sound casual. "Didn't see you there. Yeah, everything's fine. Just... talking to the baby."

She gives a small, nervous laugh, avoiding your gaze. 

"Sakura, huh?" you ask gently, tilting your head. "That's a beautiful name."

rubric.analysis: 当前任务处于修订阶段，需基于提供的剧本片段（Natsuki在公园外学校处的独白及'我'的回应）设计核验标准。交付物必须严格还原场景位置、角色动作、台词内容及对话结构。核心逻辑约束在于Natsuki对未出生孩子Sakura的提及是心理独白而非物理互动，任何修改不得破坏这一设定或添加原文不存在的物理接触。权重分配上，场景与背景准确性设为最高优先级（30%），确保故事发生的时空坐标无误；角色动作细节（手抚腹部）次之（25%），体现角色状态；台词完整性（包含对Sakura的称呼及明日见面的期待）再次之（25%），确保情感表达准确；最后是'我'的回应台词（20%），保证对话互动的完整性。所有标准均聚焦于文本还原度，不涉及额外情节创作。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回答中明确提到了场景发生在公园（'in the park'），符合任务设定中关于公园的描述，但未明确提及‘位于学校外部’这一具体位置限定条件。不过任务描述中的括号内容 '(In the park, just outside the school...)' 是背景设定，回答通过提及公园并延续对话情境，可视为基本满足场景位置的呈现要求，但严格来说未复现'just outside the school'的精确表述。然而考虑到对话体通常不重复背景括号内容，且明确提到公园，此处判定为满足核心场景信息。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回复内容中完全未提及场景位置，既没有标注“公园”也没有说明“学校外部”，无法确认是否满足该条件。
